  requires (bal >= 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((((bal + x) >= 0) and (result == (bal + x))) or (((bal + x) < 0) and (result == bal)))
  effects pure
  example (step(5, -7) == 5)
  example (step(5, -5) == 0)
  example (step(5, 3) == 8)
{
  if ((bal + x) >= 0) then (bal + x) else bal
}

fn run(bal: Int, xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (bal >= 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (run(0, [10, -3, -20, 5]) == 12)
  example (run(0, [-5, 2]) == 2)
  example (run(7, []) == 7)
{
  match xs { [] => bal [h, ..t] => run(step(bal, h), t) }
}

fn balance(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires forall x in xs: (x != 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (balance([10, -3, -20, 5]) == 12)
  example (balance([-5, 2]) == 2)
  example (balance([]) == 0)
{
  run(0, xs)
}

fn has(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == contains(xs, x))
  effects pure
  example (has([1, 2], 2) == true)
  example (has([1, 2], 3) == false)
  example (has([], 1) == false)
{
  match xs { [] => false [h, ..t] => ((h == x) or has(t, x)) }
}

fn search(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> Int
  requires (k >= 1)
  ensures (result >= k)
  ensures not contains(xs, result)
  ensures forall i in k..result: contains(xs, i)
  effects pure
  example (search([1, 2, 4], 1) == 3)
  example (search([3, 5], 1) == 1)
  example (search([], 1) == 1)
  example (search([2, 3], 2) == 4)
{
  if has(xs, k) then search(xs, (k + 1)) else k
}

fn first_missing(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires forall x in xs: (x > 0)
  ensures (result >= 1)
  ensures not contains(xs, result)
  ensures forall i in 1..result: contains(xs, i)
  effects pure
  example (first_missing([1, 2, 4]) == 3)
  example (first_missing([3, 5]) == 1)
  example (first_missing([]) == 1)
  example (first_missing([1, 1, 2, 2]) == 3)
{
  search(xs, 1)
}

  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures forall y in result: (y < x)
  ensures forall y in result: contains(xs, y)
  ensures forall y in xs: ((y >= x) or contains(result, y))
  effects pure

  example (less_than([7, 2, 9, 4], 1) == [])
  example (less_than([], 3) == [])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => if (h < x) then ([h] ++ less_than(t, x)) else less_than(t, x) }
}

  requires (a != b)
  ensures ((result == a) or (result == b))
  ensures ((result <= a) and (result <= b))
  effects pure
  example (min2(3, 5) == 3)
  example (min2(5, 3) == 3)
{
  if (a < b) then a else b
}

fn min_of(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 1)
  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures contains(xs, result)
  ensures (len(less_than(xs, result)) == 0)
  effects pure
  example (min_of([7, 2, 9, 4]) == 2)
  example (min_of([5]) == 5)
  example (min_of([3, 8, 1]) == 1)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => match t { [] => h [_, ..r] => min2(h, min_of(t)) } }
}

  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures not contains(result, v)
  ensures forall y in xs: ((y == v) or contains(result, y))
  ensures forall y in result: contains(xs, y)
  effects pure

  example (remove_value([5], 5) == [])
  example (remove_value([1, 2], 3) == [1, 2])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => if (h == v) then remove_value(t, v) else ([h] ++ remove_value(t, v)) }
}

  requires (k >= 1)
  requires (k <= len(xs))

  ensures (len(less_than(xs, result)) == (k - 1))
  effects pure

fn less_count(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> Int
  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures ((result >= 0) and (result <= len(xs)))
  effects pure
  example (less_count([], 3) == 0)
  example (less_count([5, 1, 3], 3) == 1)
  example (less_count([5, 1, 3], 6) == 3)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if (h < x) then (1 + less_count(t, x)) else less_count(t, x) }
}

fn has(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == contains(xs, x))
  effects pure
  example (has([1, 2], 2) == true)
  example (has([1, 2], 3) == false)
  example (has([], 3) == false)
{
  match xs { [] => false [h, ..t] => ((h == x) or has(t, x)) }
}

fn is_rank(all: List[Int], k: Int, x: Int) -> Bool
  requires (distinct(all) and (k >= 0))
  ensures (result == (contains(all, x) and (less_count(all, x) == k)))
  effects pure
  example (is_rank([5, 1, 3], 1, 3) == true)
  example (is_rank([5, 1, 3], 1, 5) == false)
  example (is_rank([5, 1, 3], 0, 1) == true)
{
  (has(all, x) and (less_count(all, x) == k))
}

fn first_rank(all: List[Int], xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> Option[Int]
  requires (distinct(all) and (k >= 0))
  ensures ((result == None) == (not (exists x in xs: is_rank(all, k, x))))
  effects pure
  example (first_rank([5, 1, 3], [5, 1, 3], 1) == Some(3))
  example (first_rank([5, 1, 3], [5, 1, 3], 5) == None)
  example (first_rank([5, 1, 3], [], 1) == None)
{
  match xs { [] => None [h, ..t] => if is_rank(all, k, h) then Some(h) else first_rank(all, t, k) }
}

fn length(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == len(xs))
  effects pure
  example (length([]) == 0)
  example (length([4, 5]) == 2)
  example (length([7]) == 1)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [_, ..t] => (1 + length(t)) }
}

fn median_odd(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (((len(xs) % 2) == 1) and distinct(xs))
  ensures contains(xs, result)
  ensures (less_count(xs, result) == (len(xs) / 2))
  effects pure
  example (median_odd([5, 1, 3]) == 3)
  example (median_odd([8]) == 8)
  example (median_odd([4, 9, 2, 7, 1]) == 4)
{
  match first_rank(xs, xs, (length(xs) / 2)) { Some(m) => m None => 0 }
}

  requires sorted(ys)
  requires distinct(xs)
  requires distinct(ys)
  requires forall x in xs: not contains(ys, x)
  ensures sorted(result)

  ensures forall x in xs: contains(result, x)

{
  match xs { [] => ys [h, ..t] => match ys { [] => xs [k, ..u] => if (h <= k) then ([h] ++ merge_sorted(t, ys)) else ([k] ++ merge_sorted(xs, u)) } }
}
